The rule stands: ceilings ratchet down, and a raise is a decision with a name on it rather than a number that drifted. 2026-08-21, WhatsApp reminder cadence. One ceiling raised and eight lowered. The raise needs saying out loud, because the rule here is that ceilings ratchet down. /protected/receipts was ALREADY over its ceiling at 4028da4 — 144858 against 144700 — before any of this work; the hand-off's own verification list omitted quality:bundles:check, so CI had been red on it since. measurements.note: RAISED from 133300 on 2026-09-03, and it needs saying out loud, because the rule here is that ceilings ratchet down. Phase 1 of the fee-reminder upgrade put four new notices on this screen - Due soon, Final call, Late fee applied, Promise lapsed - and their chip labels, hints, rule sentences and skip wording are ~700 gzip bytes of copy the office actually reads. Two structural cuts were made first rather than raising it on the feature's word: the eight unapproved template bodies moved to campaign-bodies-v3.ts, which no ui/ or app/ file may import (1084 bytes of text that was provably unreachable from the browser, since a preview is only ever rendered for a campaign campaignFor returned and that returns approved campaigns only), and the message preview moved to a server-rendered prop (201 bytes, and it fixed a crash - campaignFor throws for an unapproved notice, so a hand-edited ?situation= blanked the screen inside a client render). Deferring the test-send panel behind next/dynamic was tried and REJECTED: it measured 479 bytes worse, because this script sums every chunk in the route's RSC manifest and a lazy chunk is still one of them. 134500 is a round number ~500 above the 134006 measured locally, matching the convention in this file and leaving the headroom CI needs - a zero-headroom ceiling is a coin flip, as the previous note records.
